# Device visitor history indicator (2026-01-23 19:25Z)

_**User**_

if a device from the device list has looked for this current users device in the past 90 seconds I want to display an eye symbol (sf symbols: eye) in the color of the device just under the battery symbol.

Do not add it to each devicerow but instead add it to the general "get all devices location" logic as a second stop (get visitor history)

The goal is to have the visitorhistory retrieved after the device-list location is retrieved - so it goes in tandem and does not add more logic or is done additionally periodically (just periodically as part of the normal update of the device lists locations)

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_


Exploring the codebase to locate the device list location retrieval, visitor history logic, and the device row UI.

If nil, requests the maximum available from server.\n    /// - Returns: The full response including server config and visitors.\n    /// - Throws: An &#96;APIError&#96; if the request fails.\n    public static func getVisitorHistoryWithConfig(serverURL: URL,\n                                                   forDeviceID deviceID: String,\n                                                   amount: Int?) async throws -&gt; MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse {\n        \n        let url = serverURL.appendingPathComponent(\"v1/GetVisitorHistory\")\n        \n        // First request with a reasonable default to get server config\n        let initialAmount = amount ?? 1000\n        let requestBody = GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody(\n            MiataruGetVisitorHistory: GetVisitorHistoryPayload(Device: deviceID, Amount: String(initialAmount))\n        )\n\n        let data: Data\n        do {\n            data = try await performPostRequest(url: url, encodablePayload: requestBody) {\n                \"[MiataruAPIClient] Requesting visitor history for device \\(deviceID) amount=\\(initialAmount) payload=\\($0)\"\n            }\n        } catch APIError.encodingError(let err) {\n            debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Encoding visitor history request failed for device \\(deviceID): \\(err.localizedDescription)\")\n            throw APIError.encodingError(err)\n        }\n\n        do {\n            let response = try jsonDecoder.decode(MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse.self, from: data)",

        "contents": "    private func pollVisitorHistory() async {\n        guard let targetId = targetDeviceId,\n              let url = URL(string: serverURL) else {\n            return\n        }\n        \n        do {\n            let visitors = try await MiataruAPIClient.getVisitorHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: ourDeviceId,\n                amount: 100  // Get enough entries to find recent visits\n            )\n            \n            await MainActor.run {\n                // Update cached history if it changed (compare by count and device IDs)\n                let hasChanged = visitors.count != cachedVisitorHistory.count ||\n                    !visitors.allSatisfy { visitor in\n                        cachedVisitorHistory.contains { $0.DeviceID == visitor.DeviceID &amp;&amp; $0.TimeStamp == visitor.TimeStamp }\n                    }\n                if hasChanged {\n                    cachedVisitorHistory = visitors\n                }\n                // Always re-evaluate mutual state based on current time, even if history hasn't changed.\n                // This ensures the state updates when the age of the last visit exceeds the exit threshold.\n                updateMutualState(targetDeviceId: targetId)\n                lastPollTime = Date()\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"[MutualNavigationDetector] Failed to fetch visitor history: \\(error)\")\n            // On error, still re-evaluate state based on cached data since time is passing\n            await MainActor.run {\n                if let targetId = targetDeviceId {\n                    updateMutualState(targetDeviceId: targetId)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Update mutual navigation state based on visitor history and hysteresis logic.\n    private func updateMutualState(targetDeviceId: String) {\n        // Find the newest visitor entry for the target device",

        "contents": "      description: Visitor History is stored on the server with every request to the location or location history information of a device. There is a server-side setting that controls up to how many Visitors the server is storing in the Visitor History before it removes the oldest one.         "contents": "        // Prefer cached history; do not navigate if cache is empty.\n        if let cachedHistory = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: device.DeviceID) {\n            if cachedHistory.isEmpty {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n            } else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    showHistoryView = true\n                }\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !device.DeviceID.isEmpty else {\n            await MainActor.run {\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\", comment: \"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\"))\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        let requestingDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        let requestID = requestingDeviceID.isEmpty ? nil : requestingDeviceID\n\n        do {\n            let data = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocationHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: device.DeviceID,\n                requestingDeviceID: requestID,\n                amount: 10000\n            )\n            let normalized = normalizeHistoryEntries(from: data)\n            let sorted = normalized.sorted { $0.TimestampDate &lt; $1.TimestampDate }\n\n            guard !sorted.isEmpty else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n                return\n            }\n\n            await MainActor.run {\n                DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(sorted, for: device.DeviceID)\n                showHistoryView = true\n            }\n        } catch let apiError as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            let message = mapHistoryAPIError(apiError)",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./Libraries/MiataruClientSwift/Definitions/Miataru.yaml",
        "range": {

        "contents": "- application/json\n      parameters:\n        - name: deviceID\n          in: path\n          type: string\n          required: true\n          description: the unique device ID of the device the location is requested from\n          default: \"7b8e6e0ee5296db345162dc2ef652c1350761823\"\n      responses:\n        default:\n          description: geoJSON formatted device location\n          schema:\n            $ref: '#/definitions/MiataruGetLocationGeoJSONResponse'\n  /GetLocationHistory:\n    post:\n      tags:\n      - getLocation\n      description: Location History is stored on the server only if the client told the server to do so using the “EnableLocationHistory” setting in the Location Update requests. For transitions of enabling/disabling that functionality - Everytime a Location Update is received by the server with “EnableLocationHistory=false” the server removes all stored Location History till that point. There is a server-side setting that controls up to how many Location Updates the server is storing in the Location History before it removes the oldest one. To request the Location History of a particular device the client sends the following POST request to the GetLocationHistory service URL. Please note that the MiataruConfig portion is optional.         "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitor: Codable {\n    public let DeviceID: String\n    public let TimeStamp: String\n\n    /// Computed property for accessing the timestamp as a Date.\n    /// The timestamp from the API is in milliseconds, so we divide by 1000.\n    public var TimeStampDate: Date {\n        if let ts = Double(TimeStamp) {\n            // Timestamps from the API are in milliseconds, convert to seconds\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ts / 1000.0)\n        } else {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Unique identifier combining DeviceID and TimeStamp for use in ForEach\n    public var uniqueID: String {\n        return \"\\(DeviceID)-\\(TimeStamp)\"\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case DeviceID\n        case TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(DeviceID: String, TimeStamp: String) {\n        self.DeviceID = DeviceID\n        self.TimeStamp = TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        DeviceID = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        // TimeStamp can come as String or number\n        if let tsString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = tsString\n        } else if let tsInt = try? container.decode(Int64.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(tsInt)\n        } else if let tsDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(Int64(tsDouble))\n        } else {\n            TimeStamp = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(DeviceID, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        try container.encode(TimeStamp, forKey: .TimeStamp)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Server configuration information from GetVisitorHistory response.\npublic struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String",

        "contents": "public struct GetLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public init(Device: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the GetLocationHistory request.\npublic struct GetLocationHistoryPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public let Amount: String\n    public init(Device: String, Amount: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n        self.Amount = Amount\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the GetVisitorHistory request.\npublic struct GetVisitorHistoryPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public let Amount: String\n    public init(Device: String, Amount: String) {\n        self.Device = Device\n        self.Amount = Amount\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for the UpdateLocation request.\npublic struct UpdateLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String\n    public var Timestamp: String\n    public var Longitude: Double\n    public var Latitude: Double\n    public var HorizontalAccuracy: Double\n    public var Speed: Double?\n    public var BatteryLevel: Double?\n    /// Altitude above mean sea level in meters\n    public var Altitude: Double?\n\n    /// Computed property für den Zugriff als Date\n    public var TimestampDate: Date {\n        get {\n            if let ms = Double(Timestamp) {\n                return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ms)\n            } else {\n                return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n            }\n        }\n        set {\n            Timestamp = String(Int64(newValue.timeIntervalSince1970))\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case Device, Timestamp, Longitude, Latitude, HorizontalAccuracy, Speed, BatteryLevel, Altitude\n    }\n\n    public init(Device: String, Timestamp: String, Longitude: Double, Latitude: Double, HorizontalAccuracy: Double, Speed: Double? = nil, BatteryLevel: Double? = nil, Altitude: Double? = nil) {\n        self.Device = Device\n        self.Timestamp = Timestamp",

        "contents": "    private func loadHistory() async {\n        // Prefer cached history for snappy resume\n        if let cached = cache.getHistory(for: device.DeviceID) {\n            debugLog(\"[DeviceHistoryMapView] Using cached history for device \\(device.DeviceID) entries=\\(cached.count)\")\n            await MainActor.run {\n                viewModel.setHistory(cached)\n                initializeTimelineIfNeeded()\n            }\n            return\n        }\n        guard let url = URL(string: SettingsManager.shared.miataruServerURL) else {\n            await MainActor.run {\n                loadError = NSLocalizedString(\"server_url_invalid\", comment: \"The server URL is invalid.\")\n            }\n            return\n        }\n        let requestingDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        let requestID = requestingDeviceID.isEmpty ? nil : requestingDeviceID\n        await MainActor.run {\n            isLoading = true\n            loadError = nil\n        }\n        do {\n            debugLog(\"[DeviceHistoryMapView] Fetching history for device \\(device.DeviceID)\")",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceBatterySymbol.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2025-01-25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct DeviceBatterySymbol: View {\n    let batteryLevel: Double\n    let deviceColor: Color\n    let size: CGFloat\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme\n    \n    init(batteryLevel: Double, deviceColor: Color, size: CGFloat = 16) {\n        self.batteryLevel = batteryLevel\n        self.deviceColor = deviceColor\n        self.size = size\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        Image(systemName: batterySymbolName)\n            .resizable()\n            .scaledToFit()\n            .frame(width: size, height: size)\n            .foregroundColor(Color.adjustedDeviceColor(deviceColor, for: colorScheme))\n            .shadow(radius: 4)\n    }\n    \n    private var batterySymbolName: String {\n        let percentage = Int(batteryLevel)\n        \n        switch percentage {\n        case 100:\n            return \"battery.100percent\"\n        case 90...99:\n            return \"battery.75percent\"\n        case 75...89:\n            return \"battery.75percent\"\n        case 50...74:\n            return \"battery.50percent\"\n        case 25...49:\n            return \"battery.25percent\"\n        case 1...24:\n            return \"battery.0percent\"\n        default:\n            return \"battery.0percent\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    VStack(spacing: 20) {\n        ",

1000 {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.0f %@\", distance, meterUnit)\n            } else {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%d %@\", Int(round(distance / 1000)), kilometerUnit)\n            }\n        } else {\n            let feetUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_feet_unit\", comment: \"Unit for feet in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let milesUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_miles_unit\", comment: \"Unit for miles in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let distanceInFeet = distance / 0.3048\n            let distanceInMiles = distance / 1609.34\n            if distanceInFeet &gt;         "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceBatterySymbol.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2025-01-25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct DeviceBatterySymbol: View {\n    let batteryLevel: Double\n    let deviceColor: Color\n    let size: CGFloat\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme\n    \n    init(batteryLevel: Double, deviceColor: Color, size: CGFloat = 16) {\n        self.batteryLevel = batteryLevel\n        self.deviceColor = deviceColor\n        self.size = size\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        Image(systemName: batterySymbolName)\n            .resizable()\n            .scaledToFit()\n            .frame(width: size, height: size)\n            .foregroundColor(Color.adjustedDeviceColor(deviceColor, for: colorScheme))\n            .shadow(radius: 4)\n    }\n    \n    private var batterySymbolName: String {\n        let percentage = Int(batteryLevel)\n        \n        switch percentage {\n        case 100:\n            return \"battery.100percent\"\n        case 90...99:\n            return \"battery.75percent\"\n        case 75...89:\n            return \"battery.75percent\"\n        case 50...74:\n            return \"battery.50percent\"\n        case 25...49:\n            return \"battery.25percent\"\n        case 1...24:\n            return \"battery.0percent\"\n        default:\n            return \"battery.0percent\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    VStack(spacing: 20) {\n        ",

NSColor analog\n#endif\n    }\n}\n\n// Zusatz-Utilities für Cache-Key und Bild-Cache\nextension Color {\n    /// Stabile RGBA-Repräsentation für Cache-Keys\n    func rgbaKey() -&gt; String {\n#if canImport(UIKit)\n        let uiColor = UIColor(self)\n        var r: CGFloat = 0, g: CGFloat = 0, b: CGFloat = 0, a: CGFloat = 0\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;r, green: &amp;g, blue: &amp;b, alpha: &amp;a)\n        return String(format: \"r%.3fg%.3fb%.3fa%.3f\", r, g, b, a)\n#elseif canImport(AppKit)\n        return String(describing: self)\n#else\n        return String(describing: self)\n#endif\n    }\n}\n\nfinal class MiataruMapMarkerImageCache {\n    static let shared = MiataruMapMarkerImageCache()\n    private let cache = NSCache&lt;NSString, PlatformImage&gt;()\n    private init() {\n        cache.countLimit = 256\n    }\n    func image(for key: String) -&gt; PlatformImage? {\n        cache.object(forKey: key as NSString)\n    }\n    func set(_ image: PlatformImage, for key: String, cost: Int = 0) {\n        cache.setObject(image, forKey: key as NSString, cost: cost)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct MiataruMapMarker: View {\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme",

        "contents": "    /// Spacing between multiple arrows on the same edge or at corners.\n    private let arrowSpacing: CGFloat = 80\n\n    /// Segment length (in points) used to visualize distance.\n    private let segmentLength: CGFloat = 3\n    /// Spacing (in points) between arrow segments for clear separation.\n    private let segmentSpacing: CGFloat = 1\n    /// Maximum number of distance segments to display.\n    private let maxArrowSegments: Int = 10\n    /// Number of arrow segments representing the distance.\n    /// Shows 1 segment per 50 km (capped by &#96;maxArrowSegments&#96;).\n    private var arrowSegments: Int {\n        let segments = Int(distanceInKM / 50.0)\n        return min(segments, maxArrowSegments)\n    }\n\n    // Computed property to determine the best text color for contrast\n    private var textColor: Color {\n        // Convert device color to UIColor to check brightness\n        let uiColor = UIColor(deviceColor)\n        var red: CGFloat = 0\n        var green: CGFloat = 0\n        var blue: CGFloat = 0\n        var alpha: CGFloat = 0\n        \n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;red, green: &amp;green, blue: &amp;blue, alpha: &amp;alpha)\n        \n        // Calculate perceived brightness using standard formula\n        let brightness = (0.299 * red + 0.587 * green + 0.114 * blue)\n        \n        // Use white text for dark backgrounds, black text for light backgrounds\n        return brightness &gt; 0.5 ? .black : .white\n    }\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        // Renders the arrow when the device is outside the visible bounds.",

UIColor.gray)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .overlay(\n            Group {\n                if copiedIDFeedback {\n                    Text(\"device_id_copied_to_clipboard\")\n                        .padding(12)\n                        .background(Color.black.opacity(0.8))\n                        .foregroundColor(.white)\n                        .cornerRadius(10)\n                        .transition(.opacity)\n                        .zIndex(1)\n                }\n            }, alignment: .top\n        )\n        .animation(.easeInOut, value: copiedIDFeedback)\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    @Previewable @State var device = KnownDevice(name: \"Testdevice\", deviceID: \"12345\", color: .blue)\n    @Previewable @State var isPresented = true\n    \n    iPhone_EditDeviceView(device: $device, isPresented: $isPresented)\n}",

## Summary

1. **Added visitor history retrieval** in `DeviceLocationRefresher.swift`:
   - After device locations are fetched, `refreshVisitorHistory()` is called
   - Fetches visitor history for the current user's device
   - Filters visitors from the past 90 seconds
   - Updates the cache with device IDs that have looked for the current user

2. **Added storage** in `DeviceLocationCacheStore.swift`:
   - Added `@Published var recentVisitorDeviceIDs: Set<String>` to track devices
   - Added `setRecentVisitorDeviceIDs()` to update the set
   - Added `hasRecentVisitor(deviceID:)` to check if a device has looked for the current user

3. **Updated DeviceRowView** to display the eye symbol:
   - Wrapped the battery symbol in a VStack with center alignment
   - Added an eye symbol (SF Symbols: "eye") that appears below the battery symbol when `cache.hasRecentVisitor(deviceID:)` returns true
   - Eye symbol uses the device color and is sized 12x12 (battery is 16x16)

The visitor history is fetched as part of the normal device location refresh cycle, so it runs periodically with the device list updates without adding separate periodic logic.

The eye symbol appears in the device color just under the battery symbol for any device that has looked for the current user's device in the past 90 seconds.
